items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: Like we did one of Billie Holiday’s, “Strange Fruit”

ctx.x: And so okay, now where’s he going with this.

Well I think, I would have conversations with him and I had conversations with Carla Bley about the same thing. I mean I listen to the jazz stations in New York, I hardly ever hear him play Carla Bley’s music. And she would complain, she’d say, “My stuff is really easy to listen to it’s just like this and this and this. I don’t understand what problem they have with it. Why don’t they play my music?” She would always get voted on in the polls and Down Beat things but very seldom would they play her music on the…
You know I didn’t even know that was him.
